summary: Huron Regional Airport (HON/KHON) is a public-use airport located in Huron, South Dakota, serving the city and surrounding Beadle County region. The airport primarily supports general aviation and seasonal traffic spikes during major events like the annual South Dakota State Fair, one of the largest agricultural expos in the Midwest. Its location in central South Dakota makes it a convenient hub for travelers exploring the James River Valley area.
faqs:
Q: What airlines serve Huron Regional Airport?
A: Huron Regional Airport is primarily served by regional carriers, with Great Lakes Airlines historically providing scheduled passenger service; current commercial options may be limited, so checking current schedules is recommended.

Q: How far is the airport from downtown Huron?
A: The airport is located just a few miles east of downtown Huron, making it a short drive of approximately 5-10 minutes to the city center.

Q: Does the airport have car rental services?
A: Rental car availability may be limited at this regional airport, so visitors are encouraged to arrange transportation in advance or check with local providers in Huron.

Q: Are there any major events that increase airport traffic?
A: Yes, the South Dakota State Fair held annually in late summer brings a significant influx of visitors and aircraft to the region.
transport_tips: Huron Regional Airport is conveniently located just east of the city, accessible via US Highway 14, making ground transportation straightforward. Taxis and local shuttle services operate in the area, though availability may be limited outside of scheduled flight times. Having your own vehicle or arranging a rental in advance is recommended for greater flexibility when traveling through Huron.
local_tip: If visiting during the South Dakota State Fair in late August or early September, book accommodations and rental cars months in advance, as the population of Huron effectively doubles during this major annual event that draws visitors from across the Midwest.
